hero.headline: Frontend Engineer building scalable and automated systems.
hero.description: I build modern, scalable, and high-performance interfaces. I combine advanced frontend with automation and AI to create solutions that drive real impact.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Frontend Engineer with experience building complex web applications in production. My approach goes beyond code: I design scalable architectures, optimize user experiences, and automate processes to maximize impact.
about.p2: I have solid experience with React, Astro, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems. I've led the frontend development of platforms handling thousands of users, always prioritizing performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
about.p3: What sets me apart is my hybrid capability: I combine high-level frontend development with automation (n8n, RPA, Power Automate) and AI integration. This allows me to build complete solutions that solve real business problems.
about.highlight3_desc: n8n, RPA, Power Automate, AI integration

project1.title: Headless E-commerce Platform
project1.description: High-performance online store with headless architecture handling massive traffic spikes.
project1.problem: The client needed a fast online store capable of handling traffic spikes of 10K+ simultaneous users without performance degradation.
project1.solution: Headless architecture with Astro on the frontend, REST API backend, and smart caching with incremental revalidation for product pages.
project1.tech: Astro, React, TypeScript, REST API, CDN, SSG

project2.title: Automation Dashboard
project2.description: Centralized control panel for monitoring and managing enterprise automation flows in real time.
project2.problem: The company managed 50+ automation flows without centralized visibility, causing silent failures and data loss.
project2.solution: React dashboard with real-time flow visualization, smart alerts, and automatic restart. Direct n8n API integration.
project2.results: 🔥 Failure detection -80% · Zero downtime for 6 months
project2.tech: React, TypeScript, n8n API, WebSockets, Chart.js

project3.title: Smart Multichannel CMS
project3.description: Centralized system to manage and distribute content across multiple platforms simultaneously.
project3.problem: The content team was manually updating 4 different platforms, consuming 20+ hours per week with constant sync errors.
project3.solution: React frontend with n8n automations that distribute content to WordPress, Shopify, and social media automatically.
project3.tech: React, n8n, WordPress API, Shopify API, Node.js

project4.title: WhatsApp AI Chatbot
project4.description: Intelligent conversational assistant integrated into WhatsApp for 24/7 customer support powered by GPT-4.
project4.problem: Company with no after-hours customer support was losing 40% of incoming queries outside business hours.
project4.solution: Bot built with n8n + OpenAI GPT-4 trained on a custom knowledge base. Auto-escalation to human agent when needed.
project4.tech: n8n, OpenAI API, WhatsApp API, Node.js, Supabase

project5.title: Enterprise RPA System
project5.description: Process automation for reporting and data management that previously required extensive manual work.
project5.problem: The finance team spent 8 hours daily generating Excel reports manually, with high risk of human error.
project5.solution: RPA bot with Power Automate and Rocketbot that extracts data from multiple sources, processes, validates, and generates reports automatically.
project5.tech: Power Automate, Rocketbot, Excel API, SQL Server, Python

project6.title: Modern Real Estate Portal
project6.description: Property search and management platform with interactive maps and real-time advanced filters.
project6.problem: Legacy portal with 7-second load times, no dynamic filters, and outdated UX that was driving leads away.
project6.solution: Full rewrite with React + Astro SSG, Mapbox integration for interactive maps, and a filter system with no page reloads.
project6.tech: React, Astro, Mapbox GL, TypeScript, REST API, Algolia

automation.title: Automation & AI
automation.description: Automation isn't just a tool, it's a mindset. I apply systems thinking to identify repetitive processes and create solutions that scale.
automation.n8n_desc: I design and implement complex automation workflows that connect multiple services and APIs. From data processing to smart notifications.
automation.rpa_desc: Experience with Rocketbot and Power Automate for automating enterprise processes involving legacy systems, Excel, and internal platforms.
automation.ai_desc: I use AI models to power automations: document classification, content generation, data analysis, and vibe coding to accelerate development.
automation.impact1: 500+ hours saved monthly on automated processes
automation.impact2: Integration of 20+ different services and APIs
